criteria.name: specificity
criteria.description: Story has concrete, named details — specific character motivations, named stakes, defined arc shape. Not vague genre conventions or placeholder text.

criteria.name: structure
criteria.description: Story beats are logically ordered. Each beat builds on the previous. The arc has clear escalation and a satisfying dramatic shape.

criteria.name: downstream_utility
criteria.description: The output would give a character/scene generator enough concrete material to work with. All required fields are populated with usable, non-placeholder content.

criteria.name: originality
criteria.description: The premise and beats feel fresh — avoids obvious genre clichés and predictable moves. The specific combination of elements is interesting.
